metadata.formula: s=base then iterative MulDiv(s,68,100) depths 1..4; H=MulDiv(s,96,7200), W=MulDiv(s//2,96,7200); CreateFontW(-H,W,0,0,400,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,0,face)
metadata.units: Raw GDI SIZE/TEXTMETRIC are MM_TEXT memory-DC logical pixels; at assumed 96dpi, compare cy*75 against H*75 HU. This is not an HNC wrapper or native-save-context measurement.
metadata.scope: gdi32 only; CreateCompatibleDC(NULL); no screen DC, rendering, HNC execution, process operations, Hwp, COM, GUI or request creation.
metadata.font_realization: Requested face only, no new font registration; cmap support flagged. Actual realized face not queried; missing cmap widths/heights may describe default/replacement glyphs.
metadata.interpretation: No fitted size/script corrections. Equality here does not prove HNC wrapper SIZE.cy equality under native mapping/modes.
